answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is a refundable entry bond: each new agent must lock scarce capital before it can trade. Picture honest agents as an orchard whose trees each cost a real voyage of staked funds to plant. Spinning up a thousand fake identities means posting a thousand separate bonds, draining an attackers reserve like a lagoon drying out, while random audits slash the stake of any agent caught misbehaving. The attackers cost thus scales linearly with every identity minted.
